what: When the point 100px below the top edge of the title touches the bottom of the screen, then .5s later the frame moves into place from 10px to the right, .99 scale and transparent over .8s ease, while the two-tone accent gradient text is wiped in from the left, width 0 → 100%. Beneath it, a faint gray copy sits 10px to the right to preview where the paint will land, and it is removed after 1 second. With look: fade, the copy sits in place, starts fading .6s late over .8s, and is removed at 1 second

options.delay: Delay after contact before turning on (s), default .5
options.dur: Wipe and frame arrival length (s), default .8
options.offset: How many px below the title top edge reaches the bottom of the screen, default 100
options.shift: Distance the Frame travels in from and distance the copies are spread apart (px), default 10
options.pad: Extra margin (px) added to the measured width, default 20 — so the last slanted letter isn’t cut off
options.hold: Seconds until the copy is detached after turning on, default 1
options.look: fade: The copy is laid in place without moving out, then starts fading .6s late (old panel interactiveTitle) — the release timing is the same
